answer: Each identity must pass latency triangulation: three beacons ping it at random moments, and only a machine on a distinct network knoll - with its own round-trip signature - passes. When ten identities share one ocean-crossing route, a violet alert fires: re-check plus a 40 POA bond burn per suspect. One laptop cannot fake ten locations; each fake needs its own rented machine and link, so ten fakes cost ten machines and the price rises with every identity added.
